en: The postcard consists of two sides. The front side features a black-and-white photograph of a railway station building with the sign 'STÖDE' above the main entrance. The scene includes several people standing on the platform and stairs, dressed in early 20th-century fashion. Trees and shrubbery partially obscure parts of the wooden building. Text in the upper right identifies it as 'Stöde. Järnvägsstationen' (Stöde Railway Station). The back side contains handwritten text in Swedish, with an address to 'Fröken Rut Nilsson, Grefvie,' dated 1918. Printed indications show the publisher as 'ANDERS ERIKSSON' and the printer as 'SVENSKA LITOGRAFISKA AB STOCKHOLM'. There is a faded postal stamp, and the left side contains a personal message.
